newsitem.title: USA: Brent crude mixed in late U.S. paper trading.
newsitem.headline: Brent crude mixed in late U.S. paper trading.

text.p: North Sea benchmark Brent crude was mixed in late U.S. paper trading on Tuesday, traders said.
Two full boats of July Brent changed hands, an exchange for physical deal at $19.20 and a full boat at $19.25 a barrel. The July contract on London's IPE settled at $19.23 a barrel.
Three partial July cargoes also traded at $19.20, $19.25 and $19.29 a barrel.
Intermonth spreads were weaker. June/July Brent moved at minus eight cents a barrel, with talk around minus eight to minus six cents versus minus three at minus one cent earlier.
July/August traded at minus 12 cents a barrel, with talk around minus 12 to minus nine cents. The spread moved earlier at minus seven cents.
August/September was also softer at minus nine to minus seven cents, compared to minus six at minus three earlier in the day.
